description: Open on an arresting, unexpected image that stops the scroll (an out-of-place subject, a bold tableau) before the ad resolves into the product's world.
openingDirective: Open on ONE arresting, unexpected image — a striking, slightly out-of-place visual that instantly grabs the eye — held for a beat before the scene resolves toward the product.
scriptToneNote: Let the image carry the first beat; little or no spoken words over it.

description: A jarring, against-the-grain first frame that breaks the viewer's scroll pattern.
openingDirective: Open on a sudden PATTERN INTERRUPT — an abrupt, against-expectation first frame (an unexpected motion, cut or reveal) that breaks the scroll before easing into the scene.

description: Open ON the pain or frustration the product fixes, then move toward relief.
openingDirective: Open ON the problem — show the small, relatable frustration the product solves in the very first beat (a real moment of friction), so the relief lands when the product appears.
scriptToneNote: Empathetic; name the pain plainly, never preachy.

description: Tease the 'before' state or the transformation up front to set up a satisfying reveal.
openingDirective: Open on the BEFORE — the unimproved state, or a quick tease of the transformation to come — so the 'after' reveal later in the ad pays it off.

description: Open on a 'that's so me' everyday moment the target viewer instantly recognizes.
openingDirective: Open on a RELATABLE everyday moment the viewer instantly recognizes as 'that's me' — a true-to-life little scene — before the product enters it.

description: A candid, slightly vulnerable admission spoken straight to camera that earns trust fast.
openingDirective: Open on a candid CONFESSION to camera — the speaker admits something honest or slightly vulnerable in the first beat ('I didn't believe it either…'), spoken directly to the lens.

description: Layer an intriguing, unresolved line or question over the opening that the ad then answers.
openingDirective: Layer an intriguing, unresolved tease over the opening — a short spoken line or question that opens a curiosity gap the rest of the ad pays off; keep it spoken or implied, not a busy on-screen graphic.

description: Open on a bold, specific statistic that frames the cost of the problem (a shocking number). Service/B2B cold-open.
openingDirective: Open on a bold, specific STAT that frames the problem — a shocking number stated and shown large on-screen for a beat (e.g. a wasted-spend or lost-hours figure) — before the scene resolves toward the service.
scriptToneNote: Lead with the number; concrete, not hype.

description: Open on a sharp, direct question that names the viewer's pain and demands an answer. Service/B2B cold-open.
openingDirective: Open on a sharp, direct QUESTION to the viewer that names their pain ('Still losing hours to X?') — spoken or shown in the first beat — that the rest of the ad answers.
scriptToneNote: One pointed question; make them feel seen.
